## Verification Checklist

- [ ] No copyrighted game assets, binaries, full script dumps, Steam IDs, or personal local paths included.
- [ ] All modified `.svg` assets parse cleanly as XML with explicit `viewBox`, high Light/Dark contrast, and zero external `<image>` or `<script>` tags.
- [ ] Relative Markdown links resolve cleanly and release links target explicit tags or `/releases` (no floating latest-release alias).
- [ ] Canonical documentation updates are synchronized across `docs/README.{en,ja,zh-Hant,zh-Hans}.md` (or explicitly flagged if translation sync is separate).
